column1: # Memory-tuning source of truth for the fleet.
# One row per node, tab-separated. Two keys for the same row:
#   - `ssh_target` matches apply.sh when re-syncing a live fleet
# Both consumers pick their key and share the same limits, so there is one
# Values carry a soft reclaim step: High < Max. Max stays below the node's
# MemAvailable (see the spec) — a limit above available RAM is a fake fuse,
# the node OOMs before the cgroup counts that high.
# A dash (-) means the service does not run on that node; its drop-in is left
# short   ssh_target                   ws_high  ws_max  ss_high  ss_max
